svg.title: One streamed task from the card read to the close
svg.desc: Two lifelines, planner and test-runner at localhost:41241. The planner reads the agent card, sends SendStreamingMessage with a new messageId and no taskId, and gets HTTP 200 with text/event-stream. Nine numbered stream frames follow: the task 728ba084 in TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED, a statusUpdate to TASK_STATE_WORKING, five artifactUpdate frames that build test-log.txt, the last with lastChunk, one artifactUpdate for summary.json, and a statusUpdate to TASK_STATE_COMPLETED. Only frames 1, 2 and 9 carry a timestamp, at 09:00:01.750Z, 09:00:02.000Z and 09:00:02.250Z. Then the server closes the stream, with no final flag.

g.text: Checking out 9f3c2e1 and starting the suite
the server closes the stream after frame 9, with no final flag
